cards.title: 题型
rows: 5 段较长对话或独白，共 15 题。

cards.title: 课程训练设置
rows: 5 段对话，共 5 题，三选一。
2 段材料，共 6 题，三选一。
短对话和较长材料均采用四选一。
cards.note: 以上为本课程的建议，不是官方规定。官方样卷的听力题是三选一。各部分的官方时长尚未确认。

items.stem: How many short conversations are in the sample's first listening section?
options: Five short conversations
Five longer recordings
Fifteen short conversations
Fifteen longer recordings
items.why: 第一节为 5 段短对话，第一项符合材料数量和类型。

items.stem: How are the longer recordings played in the sample?
options: Each short conversation is played once.
Each longer recording is played twice.
Each longer recording is played once.
Each short conversation is played twice.
items.why: 第二节的较长材料每段播放 2 遍，第二项符合播放方式。

items.stem: Which description fits the sample's second listening section?
options: Five short conversations and five questions
Fifteen short conversations and five questions
Five longer recordings and fifteen questions
Fifteen longer recordings and five questions
items.why: 第二节为 5 段较长材料，共 15 题。第三项的材料数和题数都与此一致。

items.stem: What is the score for each listening question in the sample?
options: Half a point per question
One point per question
Two points per question
One and a half points per question
items.why: 样卷听力每题 1.5 分，第四项与分值一致。

items.stem: How does the sample differ from the course quiz?
options: The sample has three choices; the quiz has four.
The sample has four choices; the quiz has three.
Both use three choices for each question.
Both use four choices for each question.
items.why: 样卷听力单选为三选一，课内小测为四选一，第一项对应两者。

items.stem: Which statement describes the listening time?
options: The sample fixes four minutes for short conversations.
The four-minute short practice is a course setting.
The sample fixes nineteen minutes for all listening.
The nineteen-minute course mock is an official section time.
items.why: 课程训练设置表列出短对话练习 4 分钟，并注明是本课程的建议。第二项说的就是这一点。
